name: Territory Cluster Routing
description: Group accounts by geographic cluster and sequence visits to minimize travel time while maximizing face-to-face coverage of high-priority targets.

components.name: Geographic clustering
components.description: K-means style grouping of accounts by lat/long proximity

components.name: Priority-weighted sequencing
components.description: Order clusters by aggregate priority score, visit highest first

components.name: Buffer insertion
components.description: Insert 15-min buffers between clusters for unplanned detours

decisionRules: If cluster has >3 high-priority accounts, schedule full day
If travel time exceeds 60 min between clusters, split across days

complianceNotes: No external communication or claim modification involved.

name: Stakeholder Influence Matrix
description: Map stakeholders on a 2x2 influence-vs-interest grid and tailor engagement frequency and depth accordingly.

components.name: Influence-interest scoring
components.description: Score each stakeholder 1-5 on influence and interest dimensions

components.name: Quadrant assignment
components.description: Assign stakeholders to Manage Closely / Keep Satisfied / Keep Informed / Monitor quadrants

components.name: Cadence by quadrant
components.description: Weekly for Manage Closely, biweekly for Keep Satisfied, monthly for Keep Informed, quarterly for Monitor

decisionRules: If stakeholder influence >4 and interest <2, escalate to director
If stakeholder is formulary decision-maker, always assign Manage Closely

complianceNotes: Engagement frequency must respect do-not-contact lists and approved channel preferences.

name: Batched Communication Windows
description: Consolidate email and message responses into two dedicated windows per day (morning and late afternoon) to preserve deep-work blocks.

components.name: Time-boxed response windows
components.description: Process inbox only at 9:00-9:30 and 16:00-16:30

components.name: Priority triage
components.description: Flag messages from authority figures or with deadline <24h for immediate response outside windows

components.name: Deep-work protection
components.description: Block calendar 10:00-12:00 and 13:00-15:30 for focused work, no notifications

stepOrder: Triage by sender authority and deadline urgency
Batch similar responses (approvals, status updates, info requests)
Close inbox and enter deep-work block
decisionRules: If sender is direct manager or compliance officer, respond immediately regardless of window
If email contains regulatory deadline, escalate outside batch window

complianceNotes: Must not delay compliance-critical or regulatory communications beyond 4 hours.

name: Data-Driven Account Targeting
description: Use historical prescribing data, formulary status, and engagement history to compute a dynamic priority score for each account, updated weekly.

components.name: Multi-signal scoring
components.description: Weighted composite of Rx volume (40%), formulary status (25%), last-visit recency (20%), access level (15%)

components.name: Decile-based tiering
components.description: Assign accounts to deciles; focus field time on top 3 deciles

components.name: Weekly recalibration
components.description: Recompute scores every Monday using latest CRM and claims data

stepOrder: Pull latest Rx, formulary, and CRM data
Feed target list to route optimizer
decisionRules: If account drops >2 deciles in one week, flag for investigation
If new product launch, boost accounts in launch territory by 1 decile

complianceNotes: Data sources must be HIPAA-compliant. No patient-level targeting. Aggregate only.

name: Proactive Compliance Pre-Check
description: Before any external communication or content distribution, run a automated compliance pre-check against approved claims, formulary status, and channel rules.

components.name: Claim verification
components.description: Cross-reference every claim in draft against approved claims database

components.name: Channel rule enforcement
components.description: Verify recipient channel preferences and do-not-contact status

components.name: Fair-balance check
components.description: Ensure safety information is present and proportionate to benefit claims

stepOrder: Check each claim against approved database
Verify recipient DNC and consent status
If all pass, approve for sending
If any fail, flag for revision
decisionRules: If any claim is not in approved database, block sending and escalate
If recipient is on DNC list, block and log
If safety info missing, block and request addition

complianceNotes: This strategy is itself a compliance control. It must never be bypassed or weakened.

name: Cross-Functional Sync Cadence
description: Establish a structured weekly sync between field, medical affairs, and market access to share intelligence and align on territory priorities.

components.name: Standing weekly meeting
components.description: 30-min structured sync with rotating facilitator

components.name: Pre-circulated brief
components.description: Each function submits a 1-page brief 24h before sync covering wins, blockers, and asks

components.name: Action item tracking
components.description: Capture action items with owner and due date; review at next sync

stepOrder: Review action items at next sync
decisionRules: If no briefs submitted by deadline, sync is cancelled and rescheduled
If >3 action items are overdue, escalate to functional heads

complianceNotes: No patient-level data or unapproved claims may be discussed in sync briefs.

name: Time-Block Discipline
description: Allocate the workday into fixed blocks for proactive work, reactive work, admin, and learning, with strict boundary enforcement.

components.name: Fixed block schedule
components.description: Proactive 60%, Reactive 20%, Admin 10%, Learning 10%

components.name: Boundary enforcement
components.description: Calendar blocks are marked busy; notifications silenced during proactive blocks

components.name: Weekly review
components.description: Friday 30-min review of actual vs planned time allocation

stepOrder: Plan blocks for upcoming week on Friday
Set calendar blocks and notification rules
Track actual time spent per block
decisionRules: If reactive work exceeds 30% in a day, flag for root-cause analysis
If learning blocks are skipped >2 weeks, alert manager

complianceNotes: Reactive blocks must still accommodate compliance-critical communications within 4 hours.

name: Dynamic Resource Reallocation
description: Monthly review of resource allocation across territory activities, shifting budget and time from low-yield to high-yield activities based on ROI tracking.

components.name: ROI tracking per activity
components.description: Track time and budget spent per activity category and compute estimated ROI

components.name: Low-yileld identification
components.description: Flag activities in bottom quartile of ROI for reduction or elimination

components.name: Reallocation rule
components.description: Shift 50% of saved resources to top-quartile activities, 50% to experimental new activities

stepOrder: Compile monthly activity and spend data
decisionRules: If activity is compliance-mandated, exclude from reallocation
If experimental allocation fails after 2 months, revert to proven activity

complianceNotes: Reallocation must not reduce compliance-mandated activities. Transfer-of-value rules apply to all reallocated spend.
